title: Enhanced moisture and thermal stability of transparent electrodes via crosslinking for large-area flexible organic photovoltaic modules
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05154H, Paper
Xin Lu, Yang Liu, Ruiyu Tian, Xingjie Liu, Yuanyuan Wang, Yinhua Zhou
Crosslinking enhanced the thermal and moisture stability of the AgNWs-em-PVA flexible transparent electrode, which enabled the fabrication of large-area (52.3 cm2), flexible organic photovoltaic modules with a power conversion efficiency of 14.78%.
